main.description: An offer or a request in one market.

direction.description: Offering something, or asking for it.

market.description: Standard market name from the markets directory.

role.description: The poster's role, one of the market file's roles.

remote.description: True when the work happens online.

expires.description: Optional. After this the post is stale.

price.description: The price block. Per hour, per day, per job: the app multiplies before funding, one escrow per payment.

amount.description: Amount in whole units of the token, as decimal text: "25", "12.50".

mint.description: The token, named by its mint's address on Solana, base58. Any classic token; which tokens an index weighs is the index's call.

terms.description: The terms every deal made from this post is created on, set by the poster per post. Required on an offer, where they are the seller's; a request's terms come from the seller who answers it. A market file only suggests starting values.

autoReleaseDays.description: Days after the clock starts when the money goes to the seller unless the buyer has objected.

cancellationSteps.description: Up to four steps, deadlines strictly rising, none after auto-release. Absent: the buyer cannot cancel alone once the seller has accepted.

arbiter.description: Optional. The key that may decide any split once the seller has accepted, base58. Absent: no arbiter.

cancellationStep.description: Before this deadline the buyer may cancel alone and get this percent back; the rest goes to the seller.

hours.description: The deadline, in hours from the clock start. Negative: before the service time.
